It separates observed current state from canonical targets, preserves proof maturity, and returns missing-evidence requirements instead of inventing current facts.
defaultPrompt: Audit this VIIVERSION brand or website material against the approved brand and proof rules.
Plan a VIIVERSION product or GTM direction without inventing current commercial facts.
Check whether this public VIIVERSION claim is supported by the available proof.
Structure this VIIVERSION brand or product task and identify the safest next step.
